genes.name: energy_start
genes.hypothesis: Before the LP polish, relax each start by L-BFGS on a smooth soft-min energy, (1/p) log sum over all triples of area^-p (plus log hull area for the convex variant). The energy spreads all triangles at once, so the polish starts in a better basin and needs fewer LP solves than when it must untangle a raw random start through the active set alone.
genes.predicted: +5% to +15% mean score at equal CPU time, and several times more starts per second
genes.author: seed

genes.name: basin_hopping
genes.hypothesis: Good configurations share most of their structure, so relocating a few points of the current local optimum (each to the best of a handful of random spots) and re-polishing climbs faster than independent random restarts; after hop_patience failures the chain restarts from scratch.
genes.predicted: +3% to +10% mean score for n >= 20 at equal CPU time
genes.author: seed

genes.name: symmetry
genes.hypothesis: Searching inside a symmetric subspace divides the number of free coordinates by the group order, and many leaderboard entries are symmetric (square: C2, C4, D2, D4; triangle: C3, D3 through the affine map (x, y) -> (y, 1 - x - y); convex: D2 to D6). The configuration is built from orbits of n // order parameter points plus n mod order free points, polished inside the subspace, then released for a free polish. Choices that do not preserve the region (rot3 or rot5 on the square, anything but rot3 and mirror on the triangle) fall back to none.
genes.predicted: +2% to +8% best-of-seeds when n is a multiple of the group order; negative for sizes whose best configurations are asymmetric (square n = 29, 31, 33 to 36)
genes.author: seed

genes.name: active_per_point
genes.hypothesis: Each LP keeps the active_per_point * n smallest triangles. A local optimum has about 2n ties, so too few rows make steps that other triangles then veto, and too many make every LP slower.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: trust_radius
genes.hypothesis: Initial half-width of the box trust region of the LP step, in coordinate units; it adapts afterwards, so this mostly sets how violent the first steps from a start are.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: coarse_tol
genes.hypothesis: A start is polished only until the LP predicts a relative gain below this; cheaper triage of bad starts against the risk of misjudging a slow-converging good one.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: promise_gap
genes.hypothesis: A coarsely polished start within this fraction of the incumbent gets the full polish (and, with a symmetry, the release); the rest are dropped.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: energy_power
genes.hypothesis: Exponent p of the soft-min energy: small p balances all triangles, large p approximates the true minimum but is stiff for L-BFGS.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hop_points
genes.hypothesis: Number of parameter points relocated per hop; one is a small neighbourhood, many is close to a restart.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hop_candidates
genes.hypothesis: Random spots tried for each relocated point; the one that leaves the largest smallest triangle is used. One is a blind move, many is a greedy best-spot reinsertion.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hop_patience
genes.hypothesis: Consecutive failed hops before the chain is abandoned for a fresh random start.
